subtitle: When Kanchi Stirred and the Pallava Lion Awoke

panels.action: Simhavishnu Pallava stands on Kanchipuram’s ramparts, hand on sword-hilt, silk cloak stirring in a dry wind as the ancient temples and flat Tamil plain stretch to the horizon under a hazy dawn sky.

dialogue.text: In the mid-sixth century, Simhavishnu of Kanchi rose from the Kalabhra-shadowed Tamil land to forge Pallava power, Vaishnava devotion and Sanskrit learning into a new southern age.

i18n.hi: छठी सदी के बीच, कांची के सिंहविष्णु ने कालभ्रों की छाया भरी तमिल भूमि से उठकर पल्लव शक्ति, वैष्णव भक्ति और संस्कृत विद्या से नया दक्षिणी युग गढ़ा।

panels.action: A misty bird’s-eye view of the Tamil country: patchwork fields, hillocks, scattered shrines and small market towns, with no single city dominating, conveying a land of many modest centers rather than a broken wasteland.

dialogue.text: Later poets spoke of a Kalabhra night, but scholars now see shifting chiefs, monastic grants and new groups rising, not a land in ruins.

i18n.hi: बाद के कवि इसे कालभ्रों की रात कहते रहे, पर विद्वान अब इसमें बदलते सरदार, मठों को दी गई भूमियाँ और उठते नए समूह देखते हैं, न कि उजड़ा हुआ देश।

panels.action: A modest but fortified Kanchipuram of the sixth century: brick ramparts, an early temple complex, monks and brahmanas walking, merchants unloading carts at a city gate under watchful sentries.

dialogue.text: Among these centers stood Kanchipuram, old northern Tamil city, where Pallava chiefs guarded trade routes and temple lands while stronger powers battled farther south.

i18n.hi: इन केंद्रों में कांचीपुरम भी था, पुराना उत्तरी तमिल नगर, जहाँ पल्लव सरदार व्यापार मार्ग और मंदिर की ज़मीनें सँभालते थे, जबकि बड़े बल दक्षिण में भिड़ते थे।

panels.action: In a palace hall lit by oil lamps, the elder king Simhavarman III sits in council; beside him, a young Simhavishnu listens intently, fingers on a rolled palm-leaf map of Tondaimandalam and the southern frontiers.

dialogue.text: Simhavishnu, son of Simhavarman III, grew watching the Pallavas hold Tondai against rivals, hearing of Kalabhra claims in the south and the old Pandya name whispered in debate.

i18n.hi: सिंहविष्णु, सिंहवर्मन तृतीय का पुत्र, बड़ा हुआ पल्लवों को तोण्डै बचाते देखते हुए, दक्षिण में कालभ्र दावों की बातें सुनते हुए और बहसों में फुसफुसाते पुराने पांड्य नाम के साथ।

panels.action: Close on Simhavishnu’s face in his youth, eyes lowered in concentration as he studies a palm-leaf manuscript; behind him, a learned brahmana gestures toward a verse in refined script.

dialogue.text: He learned Sanskrit and Tamil, law and ritual, from brahmanas and court teachers, training his mind as carefully as his sword arm.

i18n.hi: उसने संस्कृत और तमिल, नियम और विधि ब्राह्मणों और दरबारी आचार्यों से सीखे, मन को उतनी ही धार दी जितनी तलवार के हाथ को।

panels.action: Simhavishnu stands before a simple Vishnu shrine in Kanchipuram, hands folded, a small conch and discus icon visible on the stone image, lamp-flames steady in the stillness.

dialogue.text: Though later copper plates sing of his Vaishnava piety, the young prince’s devotion to Vishnu also marked a choice of identity in a landscape of many cults and monasteries.

i18n.hi: यद्यपि बाद की ताम्रपट्टिकाएँ उसकी वैष्णव भक्ति गाती हैं, युवा राजकुमार की विष्णु-निष्ठा भी थी अपनी पहचान चुनना, एक ऐसे भूभाग में जहाँ कई संप्रदाय और मठ थे।

panels.action: A funeral pyre burns in the palace courtyard; Simhavarman’s body lies in regal repose. Simhavishnu, now older, stands apart in armor, face set, as captains and priests watch him in tense silence.

dialogue.text: When Simhavarman III died, the mantle passed. Around the mid-sixth century, Simhavishnu took the Pallava throne, heir to a strong base but not yet to an empire.

i18n.hi: जब सिंहवर्मन तृतीय चला गया, राजदंड बदला। छठी सदी के मध्य के आसपास सिंहविष्णु पल्लव सिंहासन पर बैठा, मज़बूत आधार का वारिस, अभी साम्राज्य का नहीं।

panels.action: In the royal hall, Simhavishnu sits on the throne, one hand on the armrest, the other lifting a copper plate as scribes kneel nearby, while generals with spears stand to one side.

dialogue.text: Later Udayendiram and Kasakudi plates would praise him as a lion among kings, the ruler who began the Pallava revival from this very seat in Kanchi.

i18n.hi: बाद की उदयेंद्रम और कसाकुडी ताम्रपट्टिकाएँ उसे राजाओं में शेर बताती हैं, वही राजा जिसने यहीं कांची से पल्लव पुनरुत्थान की शुरुआत की।

panels.action: Overhead view of a wooden table strewn with rough maps: the northern Tamil coast, Kanchipuram, a line of the Kaveri river. Simhavishnu’s hand points south toward the Kaveri frontier as officers lean in.

dialogue.text: We hold Tondai. Now we test our strength to the Kaveri and beyond.

i18n.hi: तोण्डै हमारा है। अब शक्ति की जाँच कावेरी तक और उससे आगे।

panels.action: A Pallava host rides and marches out of Kanchipuram’s gates: cavalry with long spears, infantry with shields, banners bearing the Pallava emblem snapping in the wind as Simhavishnu leads them on horseback.

dialogue.text: The copper plates recall his southern campaigns, a Pallava army pressing down toward the Kaveri, probing against Pandya and Lanka-linked powers in cautious bursts of war.

i18n.hi: ताम्रपट्टिकाएँ उसकी दक्षिणी मुहिम याद करती हैं, पल्लव सेना कावेरी की ओर उतरती हुई, पांड्य और लंका से जुड़ी शक्तियों को टटोलती सतर्क युद्ध झोंकों में।

panels.action: On an open field near the river plains, two forces face off at a distance: the Pallava lines with orderly ranks, and a southern host with different standards; Simhavishnu sits mounted, observing with a commander’s calm.

dialogue.text: Our sources are sparse, shaped by Pallava praise. They name foes defeated but not the dust, fear and bargaining that marked each clash on these frontier grounds.

i18n.hi: हमारे स्त्रोत कम हैं, पल्लव प्रशंसा से ढले। वे हार चुके दुश्मन गिनते हैं, पर नहीं वो धूल, डर और सौदेबाज़ियाँ जो हर सीमा-युद्ध पर छाईं थीं।

panels.action: Simhavishnu stands on a Kaveri riverbank at dusk, armor loosened, gazing across the broad water; behind him, a reduced war camp rests, fires glowing as messengers hurry between tents.

dialogue.text: If we hold here, Kanchi’s voice will be heard in every shrine and market.

i18n.hi: अगर हम यहाँ टिक गए, तो कांची की आवाज़ हर मंदिर और बाज़ार में गूँजेगी।

panels.action: In the Kanchipuram court, Simhavishnu receives envoys bearing gifts from southern chiefs: cloth, metalwork, and a tray of palm-leaf documents; the air is formal but not hostile.

dialogue.text: Power also grew by negotiation. Tribute and treaties widened Pallava reach, binding merchants and landholders to Kanchi while rivals adjusted to the new balance.

i18n.hi: शक्ति बातचीत से भी बढ़ी। नज़राने और संधियों ने पल्लव पहुँच फैलायी, व्यापारियों और ज़मींदारों को कांची से जोड़ा, जबकि प्रतिद्वंदी नए संतुलन के आदी हुए।

panels.action: Simhavishnu sits in a quiet chamber lined with palm-leaf bundles. A Sanskrit scholar recites from a text while a Tamil poet waits with a palm-leaf, and the king listens, leaning forward.

dialogue.text: He favored learned men. Under him, Kanchi leaned toward Sanskrit courtliness while still rooted in Tamil soil, preparing ground where later Pallava rulers would shelter poets and thinkers.

i18n.hi: वह विद्वानों का मान रखता था। उसके अधीन कांची ने संस्कृत दरबारी रस अपनाया, पर तमिल मिट्टी में जमी रही, वही भूमि जहाँ आगे के पल्लव राजा कवियों और चिंतकों को आसरा देंगे।

panels.action: In a temple courtyard, brahmanas perform a Vishnu ritual; Simhavishnu stands at the edge, flanked by officials. A sculpted motif of conch and discus decorates the stone wall, subtle but clear.

dialogue.text: The plates stress his Vaishnava affiliation. Through patronage and ritual, he gave the Pallava court a Vishnu-colored thread that later bhakti saints would weave through song.

i18n.hi: ताम्रपट्टिकाएँ उसकी वैष्णव पहचान पर ज़ोर देती हैं। अनुदान और अनुष्ठानों से उसने पल्लव दरबार को विष्णु-रंगी डोर दी, जिसे आगे के भक्त कवि गीतों में बुनेंगे।

panels.action: Older now, Simhavishnu sits alone, holding a partially inscribed copper plate, its surface gleaming. His eyes are thoughtful, aware that memory can be crafted as much as deeds.

dialogue.text: He may never have seen the later plates, yet his reign became their turning point, the moment Pallava scribes chose as the dawn after the Kalabhra haze.

i18n.hi: शायद उसने बाद की पट्टिकाएँ कभी देखी भी नहीं, पर उसका शासन ही उनका मोड़ बना, वह क्षण जिसे पल्लव लिपिकारों ने कालभ्र धुँध के बाद की सुबह ठहराया।

panels.action: In the same throne hall, Simhavishnu rises from the seat, hand resting for a moment on the carved wood, as a younger successor waits in the shadows, the court watching the quiet transfer of authority.

dialogue.text: His exact dates, his every decision, lie blurred. Yet from him the line run to Mahendravarman and Narasimhavarman, to stone temples and fierce wars carved hard into history.

i18n.hi: उसकी सही तिथियाँ, हर फ़ैसला धुँधले हैं। पर उसी से रेखा महेंद्रवर्मन और नरसिंहवर्मन तक जाती है, पत्थर मंदिरों और इतिहास में गहरे खुदी उग्र लड़ाइयों तक।

panels.action: Extreme close-up of the Udayendiram copper plates: engraved letters catching light, a faint lion emblem, the name of Simhavishnu picked out in the careful strokes of the inscription.

dialogue.text: Udayendiram and Kasakudi plates tell us this: Simhavishnu stood as the first clear imperial Pallava, his reach beyond Kanchi marking a new scale of Tamil power.

i18n.hi: उदयेंद्रम और कसाकुडी ताम्रपट्टिकाएँ यह बताती हैं: सिंहविष्णु पहला साफ़ साम्राज्यवादी पल्लव था, जिसकी पहुँच कांची से बाहर तक फैलकर तमिल शक्ति की नई माप तय करती है।

panels.action: A sweeping aerial view of a later, grander Kanchipuram under clear light: early stone temples rising, busy streets and river, hinting at the city that would flourish on foundations laid in Simhavishnu’s time.

dialogue.text: By turning fragmentary memory into disciplined action, Simhavishnu helped shift Tamil history from scattered chiefs to Pallava ascendancy, setting the stage for Kanchi’s rise and the bhakti dawn.

i18n.hi: टूटी-फूटी स्मृति को सधे कर्म में बदलकर, सिंहविष्णु ने तमिल इतिहास को बिखरे सरदारों से पल्लव प्रभुत्व की ओर मोड़ा, कांची के उभार और भक्ति की सुबह की भूमि तैयार की।

title_i18n.hi: सिंहविष्णु ने खत्म की कालभ्र रात

subtitle_i18n.en: When Kanchi Stirred and the Pallava Lion Awoke
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब कांची जागी और पल्लव शेर गरजा
